tool: one-shot local procedure: hashlib.sha256 + os.stat over the cached file, onnx.load + onnx.checker.check_model, EXTERNAL-initializer scan, an op-type histogram off the graph, and a single onnxruntime CPUExecutionProvider inference. Deliberately NOT produced by bench/pinned_bytes.py -- a witness generated by the module it is meant to witness would agree with that module by construction. Re-derivable: docs/PERF.md 27.2 lists the exact commands, and bench/test_resnet.py re-checks this digest against the real cached bytes whenever they are present.
why_this_directory: NOT bench/results/rust-model-runner/. That directory holds readings taken by rust/modelrunner against a built onnxruntime_vulkan_ep.dll and is stamped by an artifact frame whose subject is that DLL; this file was not produced by that tool, is about immutable upstream bytes rather than about a build, and cannot go stale when rust/ changes.

external_data.note: graph carries no EXTERNAL initializers; the .onnx digest covers every weight byte
